name: ai-gateway-api
description: Production-ready multi-provider AI gateway REST API with deep model-level automatic provider failover. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages (serverless functions + static site). Pluggable provider architecture (OpenRouter, Poolside AI, OpenCode Zen, any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

scripts.dev: node scripts/build.mjs && wrangler pages dev out --compatibility-date=2025-03-01
